title: Justice for Joyce rally against systemic racism
location: Montreal, Place Émilie-Gamelin and René-Lévesque Boulevard
threshold_50_evidence: CityNews reports thousands gathered and marched; explicit qualitative estimate exceeds threshold.

start_date.summary: Article published the same day and states rally occurred Saturday 3 October.

location.summary: Started at Place Émilie-Gamelin and marched down René-Lévesque Boulevard.

demands.summary: Demanded action against systemic racism and addressed Premier Legault on Indigenous health care.

end_date.summary: Report says the march dispersed late afternoon on 3 October.

notes: CityNews reports peaceful gathering. Its later statement about a public inquiry is not attributed as an outcome caused by the rally. CityNews notes files from CP, so full origin is unclear; no independent-source claim.
open_questions: Check the family/organizer statement and Quebec government response if later coding needs outcome detail.

title: Toronto March for Freedom against COVID restrictions
location: Toronto downtown; Yonge-Dundas Square and march along Yonge, Avenue and Bloor corridors
threshold_50_evidence: CityNews describes hundreds gathered and marching, which is above the threshold.

start_date.summary: CityNews dates gathering to Saturday 17 October.

location.summary: Yonge-Dundas Square and a downtown route.

demands.summary: Article says group opposed COVID-19 lockdown measures and shouted slogans against Trudeau government and lockdown protocols.

notes: Separate from the same-day rally at Nathan Phillips Square for Nigeria’s SARS police reform, excluded as foreign-state target. Article calls this a local gathering, not a national simultaneous event.
open_questions: Related Toronto end-lockdown activity was reported on 26 September; determine if a broader recurring campaign changes episode boundaries.

title: Queen’s Park anti-mask protest with MPP Randy Hillier
organizer: Organizer described by report as MPP Randy Hillier
participants_original: Relatively small crowd; no numeric estimate
threshold_50_evidence: Reported crowd described only comparatively as relatively small; 50-person threshold unresolved.

start_date.summary: CityNews published 21 October and identifies Wednesday.

participants.summary: Only described as relatively small; no count.

demands.summary: Article says group challenged Ontario safety measures.

notes: Presence of two political figures does not establish a pro-party or election rally; source describes opposition to provincial policy. Ford’s vague comment that he heard a little violence is not coded as protester violence.
open_questions: Find a contemporaneous crowd estimate or leave threshold unresolved.
